besluite.fout: Place name with a compass word written without the hyphen (Suid Bokkeveld).
besluite.rede: Suid-Bokkeveld follows the same spelling rule as Suid-Afrika and Noord-Kaap, and the name and meaning are unchanged.

besluite.fout: Same missing hyphen in the compound Suid Bokkeveld-plato.
besluite.rede: Suid-Bokkeveld-plato is the correct compound spelling and matches change 1.
'Hy het net een koper naby genoeg' is natural Afrikaans and keeps the farmer as subject, so the proposal is only a lateral move.
'Verkoop dit as een' is natural, echoes the heading 'saam as een', and carries both the pooled tea and the farmers acting together, which 'as een groep' narrows.
The second 'self' is deliberate emphasis (they know the price themselves, not through someone else), so removing it loses the point.
'Hul' can only point to the farmers, since 'die koper' is singular and the paragraph is about the farmers, so naming them is unnecessary.

besluite.fout: 'Die boere wat daarin is' is vague and flat.
besluite.rede: 'Wat lede daarvan is' is the exact way to say it, matches the glossary's 'lede', and keeps the limit to the cooperative's own farmers.

besluite.fout: 'Tussen Suid-Afrika en die wêreld' sets South Africa against a whole it is part of.
besluite.rede: 'Die res van die wêreld' states the contrast exactly without adding any fact.

besluite.fout: 'Meer regverdig' copies English 'more fair' where Afrikaans uses the inflected comparative.
besluite.rede: 'Regverdiger' is the natural Afrikaans comparative and the meaning is identical.
'Voor' is an accepted conjunction in Afrikaans, so this shared glossary definition has no grammar fault and should stay as it is.
